paragraphs: At Falcon Build Contracting I introduced e-tendering on SAP Ariba and cut our average purchase order cycle from 12 to 7 days across 3 major residential projects. I'd like to bring that pace and discipline to Meridian Developments as Procurement Manager.

My 8 years in UAE construction and facilities procurement cover the core of the role: sourcing and tenders for construction and MEP packages, supplier contracts and negotiation, and day-to-day SAP MM and Ariba. I'm CIPS-qualified and already lead a team of 4 buyers.

Category management and sustainability-led sourcing are areas I'm keen to formalise. I've grouped our sourcing by project until now, and I'd welcome building category strategies around Meridian's pipeline.
I'd value the chance to discuss how I could help Meridian deliver its developments on cost and on time.
notes: Add your savings figure to the first paragraph if you have it.
Name the hiring manager if you can find them.
